head: SnowBrains app: free ski news, snow forecasts and powder alerts
dek: SnowBrains News & Weather puts ski and snowboard news and 5- and 7-day snow forecasts for more than 700 resorts in the US and Canada into one free iPhone app. It was #82 in Weather on the US App Store's free chart on 20 November.
details: Free powder alerts cover up to five resorts: when fresh snow is forecast, a notification arrives at about 6am Mountain time, with no account or email needed. Forecasts come from the National Weather Service and Environment Canada, and a snow map can be filtered by Epic, Ikon, Mountain Collective or Indy passes. Since version 1.1.1 the News tab shows a few ads; forecasts, the map and alerts stay ad-free. The app is made by SnowBrains LLC and came out on 28 October.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later), US App Store; free
means: If you ski or ride in the US or Canada, you can get snow forecasts and a heads-up on fresh snow at your chosen resorts without signing up for anything.
todo: Get it from the App Store, pick up to five resorts and set the snow amount for powder alerts.
